annotations.title: Counterparty risk check before paying an EVM address (OFAC and on-chain signals)

description: One call to vet an address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism before paying, trading or onboarding: OFAC SDN address match, account type and activity, USD holdings and, on Base, wallet risk heuristics (or contract bytecode and proxy checks), combined into a block, review or pass verdict with reasons. Cheaper than buying the parts. Screening aid, not legal advice or a security audit. Use before paying, trading with or onboarding an address. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
